title: US televangelist Jim Bakker, disgraced from sex scandal and fraud, dies at 86
summary_full: US televangelist Jim Bakker co-founded The PTL Club with his then-wife Tammy Faye before being jailed for fraud and conspiracy.
summary_public: US televangelist Jim Bakker co-founded The PTL Club with his then-wife Tammy Faye before being jailed for fraud and conspiracy.
